name: Spear Fighting (Combat)
body:
You have trained in the standard fighting style of fighting with a heavy spear in one hand and a shield in the other. This allows you to use a spear in one hand.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (spear)

Benefit(s): You may use a longspear one-handed, provided you are also wielding a shield in the other hand. When you do so, you gain a +1 bonus to your shield bonus to AC.
